label: D2: chose a2 but landed in S1 (rare), after a rewarded trial, late in the episode / low value
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the input shows last action a2 and reached state S1, i.e. a rare transition after choosing a2 (never a1->S2 rare, never common). It also needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (in_rew at D1 = 1 in all activations) and fires only late in the episode (all activations at ep_trial >= 80, ~98% of mass at >= 85), where the value head is low (99% of mass at value < 5.22). All these variables are observed at D2. a2->S1 & prev rewarded & late episode gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.32; using low value in place of episode position gives dev F1 0.64 (precision 0.48, recall 0.95, mass recall 0.99), which is the one recorded. Adding good == S2 does not help much. Many low-value a2->S1R steps after reward stay silent, so precision is incomplete. Magnitude modulators were not checked beyond this. Silent on D1, GO, all a1 trials, common transitions, and the first 80 trials of an episode.
